fields.label: Invoice
fields.description: Left blank for an Advance payment (no invoice to apply against yet) -- see record_payment_with_allocation().

fields.label: Allocation Type
fields.description: Set automatically in validate(): Advance when no invoice is set; Arrears when posted after the invoice's due_date; Current otherwise.

fields.label: Advance Remaining
fields.description: Only meaningful when allocation_type is Advance -- how much of this payment is still unconsumed by a later Invoice's Invoice._apply_available_advance().

fields.label: Payment Method
fields.description: Used as-is when tender_lines is empty (a single-tender receipt); ignored in favour of tender_lines otherwise.

fields.label: Split Tender
fields.description: Optional -- when given, must sum to exactly Amount. Each line posts against its own Payment Method's account instead of the single Payment Method above.

fields.label: Fee Allocation
fields.description: Optional -- when given, must sum to exactly Amount and only applies against this receipt's own Invoice. Doesn't affect the GL posting (still one lump Dr Cash/Bank, Cr Debtors); purely records which Invoice Line(s) this payment cleared, for per-item balance reporting.

fields.label: External Reference
fields.description: Bank transaction ID, EcoCash confirmation code, or cheque number -- the structured field bank-statement matching keys off, separate from free-text narration.

fields.label: Payer
fields.description: Defaults to the student's own Primary Guardian if left blank. Set to a Sponsor to record that this payment (or part of a split-billed invoice) came from a sponsor, not the family.

fields.label: Integrity Hash
fields.description: SHA-256 of this receipt's immutable fields, computed on submit. A printed receipt's QR code encodes this document's name; verify_receipt() recomputes and compares this hash to detect a tampered printout.

fields.label: Integrity Hash Version
fields.description: Which payload shape integrity_hash was computed under -- lets the hash formula's covered fields be extended (DEF-024) without invalidating every already-submitted receipt's existing hash. Never change a receipt's version after submit.

fields.label: Reversal Of
fields.description: Set only on a reversing Receipt — original receipts are never deleted.

fields.label: Reversal Approved By
fields.description: Set only via the approve_receipt_reversal method, by a School Head. A reversal cannot be submitted without this.
